description: PROBE 4 (2026-07-11 avenues audit §3.D): basis-constrained PSLQ for the empirical Q_β ladder coefficients c_3/c_4 against the arithmetic-dictated basis {1, √3, π², Vol(4₁), ζ(3)} (4₁ trace field ℚ(√−3)). Two-stage formalize-first: STAGE 1 is a mandatory entropy audit of the ACTUAL effective precision of the empirical coefficients, traced through the extraction chain c_3 = (Q_CODATA/Q_N2 − 1)/u³, which amplifies the relative Q_β error by 1/u³ ≈ 1.6e6 (c_4: 1/u⁴ ≈ 1.9e8). STAGE 2 (PSLQ) runs only if the effective digits exceed the PSLQ entropy bound D > n·log10(2H) + margin (PR #1805 discipline). No c_k value proposed; nothing wired.

data.c4_artifact_note: c_4 is exactly 0 by construction when c_3 is extracted exactly against the same Q_beta reference (Q_N3 = Q_CODATA identically); the quoted empirical c_4 = -0.972 is the truncation residual of a rounded c_3 — no independent empirical content exists for PSLQ. Confirms registry rung-4 tier 'empirical_fit / artifact'.

entropy_budgets.note: MINIMAL basis (kill threshold per task spec)

assertions.name: extraction_chain_reproduces_cache_c3
assertions.source: same chain + same Q_codata + same q0 as qbeta-ck-cache.witness.json (cache prints Q_codata rounded to 0.78233341) -- but NOT the same Markov convention, which is why this assertion fails. This probe computes at z_D = q**3/(q**2+1) (convention D, canonical per owner ruling R1 2026-08-15; see the z binding above), while qbeta-ck-cache.witness.json declares markov_convention='C' and its c_3 is reachable only via --historical-convention-C. The two numbers are one formula under two different z, not two evaluations of one quantity. Re-deriving the ladder under D is bean `qou-cds1`; this assertion is left FAILING on purpose -- it is the frame disagreement reporting itself, and silencing it would ratify one frame.

assertions.name: stage1_entropy_verdict_is_blocked
assertions.source: PSLQ entropy bound (PR #1805): D_eff must exceed n·log10(2H); pre-registered kill criterion — pass means the kill fired and Stage 2 was NOT run

verdict.conclusion: ENTROPY-BLOCKED: the empirical c_3 carries at most ~2 reliable digits per anchor (c_4: zero) because the extraction divides the Q_β experimental error by u³ (×1.6e6) / u⁴ (×1.9e8); even the minimal 4-term H≤100 basis needs ~9.2 digits. PSLQ was NOT run — any relation it returned would be lattice noise. The coefficients remain empirical under the arithmetic basis; no value proposed, nothing wired. Closing this avenue requires either sigma(Q_β) improved by ~9 orders of magnitude or a canonical (non-extracted) high-precision c_3 producer — i.e. the open keystone F(q) itself.

markov_convention_reason: z = q**3/(q**2 + 1) at the binding above; convention D, canonical per owner ruling R1 (2026-08-15). NOT a proposed c_3: qou-cds1 records -974.38 as a sensitivity measurement and says explicitly 'do not wire it anywhere'. The failing assertion extraction_chain_reproduces_cache_c3 is the frame disagreement with the C-framed qbeta-ck-cache.witness.json, not a chain defect.
